facts.text: Founded in 1880 in Virginia's Central Shenandoah Valley, Bridgewater College was the state's first private, coeducational college.

sources.title: Bridgewater College Named One of Best in Virginia by College Choice
sources.quote: Bridgewater College is a private, four-year liberal arts college located in the Central Shenandoah Valley of Virginia. Founded in 1880, it was the state's first private, coeducational college.
